content: Ravi Menon followed up with Diya Menon regarding her auto policy that expired on March 10th, providing a reinstatement quote and alternative plan options. Diya expressed surprise and concern over the lack of prior notice regarding the expiration and requested an explanation as well as clarification on the differences between the reinstatement quote and the new plans.

action_items: Investigate why the customer was not notified of the policy expiration
Clarify the differences between the reinstatement quote and the new suggested plans
